says: Decision 0535 moves the mutation run to the schedule, but the mutation workflow has only a workflow_dispatch trigger and its header says no cron starts it, so the code lags the decision. Ticket text: give .github/workflows/mutation.yaml the schedule 0535 sets, or start the mutation run from scheduled.yaml, and fix its header comment (lines 3 to 8) to match; 0066 and 0067 name 0535 as the schedule's home after records cleanup slice 2.
proof: `.decisions/0535-pull-requests-stay-fast-the-schedule-carries-the-rest.md:3` says everything slower moves to the 3-hour schedule, mutation included; `.github/workflows/mutation.yaml:13-14` reads `on:` then `workflow_dispatch:` with no `schedule:`, and line 8 says "No push, pull request or cron starts it"; `grep -n -i mutation .github/workflows/scheduled.yaml` prints nothing.
cost: No clock starts the mutation run, so what merged to main is mutated only when someone remembers to dispatch it, and gaps the run would ticket go unseen.
